name: kids-encyclopedia
description: 给 3-8 岁孩子的离线早教应用：七大板块知识卡 + 语音朗读 + 多题型互动练习

scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run test
scripts.check:all: npm run validate && npm run test && npm run check:reach && npm run check:media && npm run check:art && npm run check:style
scripts.cap:add: npm run www && cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run www && cap sync android
scripts.pack: npm run check && npm run cap:sync
scripts.apk: npm run pack && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
